name: Pagos Fiable
author: Pagos Fiable

sections.description:
Pagos Fiable is a payment gateway that allows you to receive card payments from your WordPress and WooCommerce online store.
The integration is simple and optimized to provide security, speed, and reliability during the purchase process.

Features

  • Full integration with WooCommerce
  • Secure payment processing
  • Automatic transaction validation
  • Clear and easy-to-use interface

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload the plugin to your WordPress site from “Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.”
  3. Activate the plugin from the administration panel.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and enable Pagos Fiable.
  5. Configure your API credentials from the WooCommerce panel.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Pagos Fiable account?

Yes. You must register an account to obtain your API credentials.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Where do I get my API keys?

From your user panel on Pagos Fiable.
